captions.caption: The video begins with a black screen.
A soldier in a green jumpsuit adjusts a mounted minigun on a military aircraft.
The soldier inspects the feed system of the large machine gun during daylight.
The soldier focuses on the upper assembly of the mounted weapon system.
A close-up shows the soldier manipulating a component on the side of the minigun.
The soldier's hands are seen working on the controls of the aircraft's weapon.
The soldier continues his maintenance on the minigun inside the open helicopter bay.
The soldier finishes preparing the helicopter's defensive weapon for a mission.
The scene transitions to a green night vision view of a helicopter on the ground.
Helicopter rotors spin rapidly on a dark airfield, seen through a night vision lens.
Bright navigation lights on the helicopter create glares in the night vision optics.
The helicopter's silhouette is clearly visible against the dark night sky.
A night vision view captures the helicopter's side profile on the tarmac.
The camera remains fixed on the idling helicopter through the green night vision view.
Green-tinted footage shows the helicopter's main rotors kicking up dust.
The helicopter's tail rotor is visible in the night vision surveillance view.
Night vision captures the aircraft preparing for takeoff on a night mission.
The view shifts to the glowing instrument panels inside the dark cockpit.
Pilots appear as silhouettes against the green-illuminated flight displays.
A close-up shows the cockpit's digital screens displaying real-time flight data.
Night vision footage shows the pilots monitoring the various aircraft systems.
The intense green glow of the cockpit illuminates the pilots and their gear.
The scene transitions back to an exterior night vision view of the helicopter.
The helicopter is seen from a distance on the dark landing strip through night vision.
Dust and debris swirl around the aircraft as the rotors spin in the dark.
A bright flash occurs near the side of the helicopter in the night vision view.
Tracer rounds are fired from the helicopter's side-mounted machine gun.
Night vision captures continuous streams of fire hitting targets on the ground.
The gunner fires a sustained burst, with tracers lighting up the night.
Streaks of light from the bullets are clearly visible against the dark landscape.
Impacts from the heavy machine gun fire are seen on the terrain below.
The night vision camera follows the path of the tracer fire across the field.
Multiple bright streaks of light indicate the trajectory of the machine gun rounds.
Ground strikes from the weapon create flashes of light in the night vision view.
The sustained fire from the helicopter's weapon system finally comes to an end.
The scene transitions back to the cockpit environment under night vision.
A crew member wearing night vision goggles looks toward the camera inside the aircraft.
Silhouettes of the pilots are visible in the green-lit cockpit during flight.
The crew member adjusts his position while looking out into the dark night.
Detailed view of the glowing cockpit controls and displays in night vision.
The pilots operate the helicopter's systems while wearing night vision equipment.
A crew member's profile is highlighted by the green light in the cockpit.
The camera captures the intricate green glow of the flight instrument panels.
The view transitions to a night vision shot of a gunner at his station.
A gunner is positioned behind a large mounted machine gun in the dark cabin.
The gunner looks through his night vision optic to acquire a target on the ground.
Close-up of the gunner's hands on the weapon's firing handles in night vision.
The gunner adjusts the mount of the machine gun to track a target area.
Night vision footage shows the gunner focused on the mission parameters.
The gunner holds the heavy weapon steady while scanning for targets in the dark.
A side profile shows the gunner and the machine gun through the night vision lens.
The gunner continues to monitor the terrain through his mounted weapon optics.
Green-tinted night vision footage shows the gunner ready to engage the enemy.
The camera pans across the gunner's station inside the dark military aircraft.
The gunner begins firing the mounted machine gun in a rapid, continuous burst.
Tracer rounds are seen flying from the weapon's barrel into the darkness.
The gunner fires a sustained stream of bullets at a target on the ground.
The machine gun's muzzle flash is clearly visible through the night vision goggles.
Tracers light up the night sky as the gunner maintains a heavy volume of fire.
The intense firing of the helicopter's mounted weapon continues in the night vision view.
